verdicts.verify_note: Crossref 10.3390/signals6010009: exact title, Boratto Tales + 7, Signals 6(1) art. 9, 2025-02-21, license CC BY 4.0. Abstract verbatim: 350 audio files, TSFEL, '14 pieces of temporal information', Differential Evolution over three ML models. The 97.60% average accuracy completes the Crossref-truncated sentence in the Semantic Scholar copy of the same abstract. MDPI article page unreachable from this rig, so publisher-page confirmation is absent.

arXiv:2505.11378v2 full text, section 3.1 verbatim: 'A total of 1008 audio clips were rendered into mel-spectrograms which produced 7221 initial images before splitting and augmentation'; class indices 0 chest / 1 mix / 2 head mix / 3 head; 80/20 split; horizontal-flip plus two brightness variants; SVM test accuracy 0.94 with per-class metrics 0.91-0.99; six CNN epochs, 68.0% validation accuracy after epoch one; labels from vocal-technique texts (Peckham 2010), not EGG. v1 states 4221 images for the same clip count - cite the version.
